text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Guess that figures. If you've lost your 
will to run, this is all you get..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't we just call it quits? Looking 
any more uncool than this would be—
choice_data_list: Even so, I'll let her run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're staring too much. ...Look away for 
just a second, will you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise... I wouldn't even be able to 
say, "I don't want to."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You're the Trainer. Do whatever you 
want.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what are you thinking? I don't 
get you at all...
